messages:
Sarah L: Heads up — planning to cut release 2026.3 to prod in ~60m. Need confirmation who is allowed to press for model-serving and runtime infra today. deploy-bot requires 'release' role + MFA; I don't have the role.
Alex P: I have the role but my MFA key expired last week. Can someone renew JIT for me?
Mila: Ops has a temporary JIT ticket for @Alex P but it's pending approval from Sec.
Security: There's an outstanding MFA enforcement flag for legacy deployers. We approved one-time JIT for the weekend but it expires this morning. Please don't bypass.
Sarah L: Ok — can we do a canary first? If deploy-bot can do rolling canary with 5% that buys time.
deploy-bot: Received request: `/deploy release=2026.3 target=prod mode=canary percent=5 pin=sha@abc123`
release-bot: Reminder: deploys to prod require two approvers if rolling to >=20% traffic.
Alex P: I can do canary but I can't escalate to full press without valid MFA. If Sec can reissue JIT for 30m I can finish.
Jess (oncall): Oncall here — hold full rollout. We're running a latency test on infra nodes in us-west-2. If the canary looks good after 10m I'll greenlight.
Infra: current node CPU spikes seen on canary test group, recommended hold. Logs:
```
[2026-03-20T09:12:34Z] node-34 cpu 92% transient
[2026-03-20T09:12:58Z] node-36 kvcache miss rate +7%
```
Mila: Thanks infra. Can we pin to sha@abc123 and roll forward with a smaller batch? Maybe 2% then 5%?
Sarah L: Fine. Alex, do you want me to request a JIT from Sec on your behalf?
Alex P: Yes please. If Sec approves, I'll press. If not, we need someone from Platform with 'release' role.
Security: JIT request filed by Sarah L for Alex P. Approving for 25 minutes. Please do not share codes. :lock:
deploy-bot: JIT token issued to Alex P (expires in 25m). Command ready: `/press sha@abc123 --target prod --canary 2->5->20`
Alex P: pressing now for 2% canary.
deploy-bot: Canary started. 2% rollout in progress. Monitor: https://console.redwood.ai/releases/2026.3
Jess (oncall): Monitoring. If error rate stays <0.5% for 15m, proceed to 5%.
Sarah L: Adding note to release notes: pin to sha@abc123, canary staged, MFA/JIT used today due to role gaps.
Mila: Also filed follow-up action: cross-team backup deployers list and MFA rotation to avoid single-person block.
Sarah L: Agreed. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
